name: platform-claude-marketplace
description: Internal Claude Code plugin marketplace. Install essentials to get started, then add individual plugins as your team needs them.

plugins.name: essentials
plugins.description: Start here. One install gives you the Platform Team default set for Claude: appsec (security scanning), code-quality, claude-security (deep vulnerability hunt with patches), security-guidance (edit-time warnings and an end-of-turn security review) and the Python/TypeScript/Go/Java language servers (each needs its binary on PATH; a missing one is skipped). Claude models only, internet-connected. Planning and review come from Claude Code's built-ins. On a self-hosted model (e.g. Qwen), install essentials-self-hosted instead.

plugins.name: essentials-self-hosted
plugins.description: Start here. Curated starter pack: superpowers (TDD, debugging, planning, git worktrees), 7-phase feature development, and 6-agent parallel PR review — all in one install.

plugins.name: appsec
plugins.description: [Platform Team] 3 security skills: appsec-scan (catalog-driven CI mirror — single-command scan (run-scan.sh) + normalized findings/triage statuses for small-model execution; admin-managed scanner preference profiles pointing at the configured instance's private GitLab CI/CD Catalog, 4 components (Fortify SCA SAST, Dependency Scanning SBOM, Secret Detection, Container Scanning) with per-component version pinning (~latest or exact tag); an optional glci engine that runs the real catalog component job locally for secret detection and container scanning, and optional GitLab-native dependency-scanning matching via a remote helper project; approval-gated fix loop and a guided Vulnerability Report triage plan) appsec-dast-sim (LLM-based DAST following OWASP WSTG v4.2 — no running app required), and security-options (points each security request at the right tool: appsec, /security-review, claude-security, security-guidance, trailofbits-skills or skill-scanner).

plugins.name: code-quality
plugins.description: [Platform Team] lint-and-validate (pre-commit gate with auto-fix formatters and linters — also in essentials), api-design-principles (REST/GraphQL + RFC 7807), openapi-spec-generation (keep OpenAPI 3.1 in sync), doc-coauthoring (ADRs, design docs, runbooks, postmortems).

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: [Vendored: obra/superpowers] 14 core developer skills: TDD, systematic debugging, planning, git worktrees, code review workflows, subagent-driven development, and more. Already bundled in essentials-self-hosted — install separately only if you want superpowers without the rest of that pack.

plugins.name: compound-engineering
plugins.description: [Vendored: EveryInc/compound-engineering-plugin] 38 skills + 50 specialised review agents: code review, architecture strategy, performance analysis, security review, data integrity, deployment verification, and more. Note: ce-gemini-imagegen requires GEMINI_API_KEY; ce-riffrec-feedback-analysis calls the OpenAI transcription API when OPENAI_API_KEY is set; ce-demo-reel can upload demo GIFs to public catbox.moe (user-approved); ce-release-notes/ce-update query the GitHub API.

plugins.name: gstack
plugins.description: [Vendored: garrytan/gstack] 54 developer productivity skills: QA, design consultation, browser automation, production safety gates (canary/guard/ship), context management, planning workflows, code review, benchmarking. Browser skills require Chrome.

plugins.name: ruflo
plugins.description: [Vendored: ruvnet/ruflo] 33 skills for AI swarm orchestration, AgentDB memory management (learning, vector-search, optimization), SPARC methodology, GitHub automation, and v3 architecture patterns. Swarm features (flow-nexus, hive-mind) require internet access.

plugins.name: getshitdone
plugins.description: [Vendored: gsd-build/get-shit-done] 66 slash commands covering the full Discuss→Plan→Execute→Verify lifecycle: /gsd task, /gsd plan, /gsd execute, /gsd verify, plus context management and team workflow commands.

plugins.name: anthropic-dev-skills
plugins.description: [Vendored: anthropics/skills] 4 skills for building with the Anthropic ecosystem: Claude API development (prompt caching, tool use, streaming, batch), MCP server building with vendored SDK reference, web app testing, and dual-mode agent patterns.

plugins.name: obsidian
plugins.description: [Vendored: kepano/obsidian-skills] 5 skills for Obsidian knowledge management: Markdown authoring, Bases queries, CLI usage, JSON Canvas diagrams, and content defuddle (simplification).

plugins.name: anthropic-feature-dev
plugins.description: [Vendored: anthropics/claude-plugins-official] 7-phase feature development workflow with 3 agents (code-architect, code-explorer, code-reviewer) and the /feature-dev slash command. Already bundled in essentials-self-hosted.

plugins.name: anthropic-pr-review
plugins.description: [Vendored: anthropics/claude-plugins-official] 6-agent parallel PR review toolkit: code simplicity, comment analysis, conversation context, test coverage, silent failure detection, type design. Plus /review-pr slash command. Already bundled in essentials-self-hosted.

plugins.name: anthropic-hookify
plugins.description: [Vendored: anthropics/claude-plugins-official] Git hooks framework for Claude Code: pre-commit, post-commit, and custom hook matchers. Includes the writing-rules skill and /hookify configuration command.

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: [Vendored: anthropics/skills] Frontend design patterns and best practices for building modern web UIs.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: [Vendored: DietrichGebert/ponytail] Lazy senior dev mode — forces the simplest, shortest solution that works: YAGNI, stdlib first, no unrequested abstractions. 6 skills (mode, review, audit, debt ledger, gain, help) plus session hooks that keep the mode active. Hooks require node on PATH.

plugins.name: agent-skills
plugins.description: [Vendored: addyosmani/agent-skills] 24 production-engineering skills (TDD, API design, security hardening, performance, planning, debugging, docs/ADRs) with a skill-discovery meta-skill injected at session start, plus 4 reviewer/auditor agents. Session hook requires jq (degrades gracefully). Note: source-driven-development needs doc access (internal mirror OK); browser-testing-with-devtools installs chrome-devtools-mcp via npx (npm mirror OK).

plugins.name: trailofbits-skills
plugins.description: [Vendored: trailofbits/skills] 33 security-engineering skills from Trail of Bits (curated subset of 17 upstream sub-plugins): audit context building, differential/variant analysis, Semgrep/CodeQL rule authoring, SARIF parsing, supply-chain and GitHub Actions auditing, insecure defaults, property-based/mutation testing, and the fuzzing testing-handbook. Some skills expect locally installed tools (semgrep, codeql, fuzzers); semgrep-rule-creator and testing-handbook-generator fetch external docs at runtime (internal mirror/proxy OK).

plugins.name: security-guidance
plugins.description: [Vendored: anthropics/claude-plugins-official] Security review for Claude-generated code: instant pattern warnings on edits, an LLM diff review on Stop, and an agentic commit reviewer catching injection, XSS, SSRF, hardcoded secrets, IDOR, auth bypass and more. Claude only, internet-connected: pip-installs claude-agent-sdk from PyPI at session start and sends each turn's diff to the Anthropic API for review — skip on airgapped installs.

plugins.name: pyright-lsp
plugins.description: [Vendored: anthropics/claude-plugins-official] Python language server (Pyright) for type checking and code intelligence. Requires `pyright-langserver` on PATH (npm install -g pyright, or pip/pipx install pyright).

plugins.name: typescript-lsp
plugins.description: [Vendored: anthropics/claude-plugins-official] TypeScript/JavaScript language server for enhanced code intelligence. Requires `typescript-language-server` on PATH (npm install -g typescript-language-server typescript).

plugins.name: gopls-lsp
plugins.description: [Vendored: anthropics/claude-plugins-official] Go language server for code intelligence and refactoring. Requires `gopls` on PATH (go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@latest).

plugins.name: jdtls-lsp
plugins.description: [Vendored: anthropics/claude-plugins-official] Java language server (Eclipse JDT.LS) for code intelligence. Requires `jdtls` on PATH (brew install jdtls, or a manual Eclipse JDT.LS install) and JDK 17+.

plugins.name: code-modernization
plugins.description: [Vendored: anthropics/claude-plugins-official] Guided modernization workflow for legacy codebases: /modernize assessment, interactive map, mined business rules, and an approved plan carried through as an upgrade, rewrite, or rebuild with independent proof the new code behaves like the old. Offline.

plugins.name: skill-scanner
plugins.description: [Vendored: getsentry/skills] Scan agent skills for security issues before adoption: prompt injection, malicious scripts, excessive permissions, secret exposure, and supply chain risks. Offline; the bundled scanner script runs under the `uv` CLI on PATH.
